name: powershell
description: Run one PowerShell command (pwsh 7 when installed, otherwise Windows PowerShell 5.1, where && and || do not exist: use ; and if ($?) { … }) in the session cwd. The result is its output, stdout and stderr in the order produced, then a status line such as [exit 0 · 1.2s]; a nonzero exit is reported, not an error. Example: {"command":"npm test","timeout":300000,"description":"Run the test suite"}. timeout is in milliseconds (default 120000, maximum 600000). For several commands make several calls, or join them with ;. Set run_in_background for servers and watchers, then use the process tool to read output or stop them. Long output keeps its start and end and names a file holding all of it.

description.description: A few words saying what the command does, shown as its title.

workdir.description: Directory to run in, relative to the session cwd.

run_in_background.description: Start the command as a background job and return its ID instead of waiting.

env_refs.description: Map child environment names to selected Raw variable names; values are references, not literal values.
